name: Rock Canyon trailhead lots at the east end of North Temple Drive (2300 North)
basis: MP Rock Canyon 'Getting There': from N Temple Drive 'the parking is directly ahead' as the road curves south; 'All parking is at the mouth of the canyon'. provo.com: trailhead is 'the end of North Temple Drive' (2300 North), two lots, directly east of the Provo Temple. roads.mjs: OSM '2300 North' runs to its east end at 40.2648,-111.6320 and this lot sits 0.08 km from that end (other candidates 0.30-0.37 km away); the Rock Canyon trail starts just east of it.

name: Dry Canyon trailhead lot at the end of Dry Canyon Drive, Orem
basis: MP Dry Canyon 'Getting There': turn left onto Dry Canyon Drive at top of Orem 2000 North; road 'ends at a paved parking lot at the mouth of Dry Canyon. Park here.'; crags reached by walking up the main trail. roads.mjs: lot is 0.01-0.03 km from the end of OSM Dry Canyon Drive and the Dry Canyon Trail start.
